challenges.title: Shows depended on a connected console
challenges.text: Permanent installations needed lighting to run on its own, without a media server or lighting desk attached.

challenges.title: Installers configure many devices on site
challenges.text: Finding, setting up and updating controllers had to be quick and consistent for every unit.

challenges.title: Networked devices are an attack surface
challenges.text: Controllers sit on building and venue networks, so the management interface and firmware updates have to be protected.

results: Controllers run recorded shows without a connected console
Fallback playback starts automatically when live data is lost
Operators run shows from a simple branded dashboard
One configuration workflow for live and standalone use
Software maintained under a support agreement
name: Advatek Lighting
headline: Control, recording and playback software for professional LED pixel lighting
overview: Advatek Lighting makes PixLite pixel controllers used in architectural, entertainment and themed lighting installations. Techlio built the software around the hardware, from discovery through design, development, deployment and support: the web-based management interface, the SHOWTime recording and playback features with their dashboard, and the tools installers use to find, configure and update controllers.

solutions.title: Web-based management interface
solutions.text: A browser interface served by the controller for configuration, monitoring and diagnostics, with the same workflow for live and standalone operation.

solutions.title: Show recording and playback
solutions.text: Lighting data recorded as scenes, organised into playlists and replayed from the controller, with frame rates monitored during record and playback.

solutions.title: Automation with triggers
solutions.text: Rules that start playlists on boot, begin a recording when a control channel reaches a value, set intensity or fall back to recorded scenes automatically if live data stops.

solutions.title: Operator dashboard
solutions.text: A configurable dashboard for playback and mode selection that venues can rearrange and brand for their own staff.

solutions.title: Security built in
solutions.text: Techlio's security baseline applied from the first sprint: OWASP-based secure coding and review, role-based access control, encryption in transit and at rest, least-privilege access to cloud resources and vulnerability scans before each release. For Advatek that covers access control on the management interface and integrity checks on firmware and configuration updates.
